LIFT / CLEAR JOB CARDS

Turn a messy job poster into an honest card

Upload or pick a poster. Lift lists only what is written: title, employer, location, pay, hours, requirements, how to apply, and any fee or deposit. If it is not on the poster, the field is NOT STATED — never guessed.

Early prototype for Myanmar migrant workers. No account. No GPS. No employer map. Your image and card stay on this device unless you download a copy. Open-weights vision (Meta Muse Glimmer self-hosted) can be plugged in later; this demo uses fixtures and pasted text because Myanmar cannot use Meta’s hosted Model API.

Fastest path for judges. Fixtures quote only OCR-visible English (or clearly readable lines). Garbled Burmese is left NOT STATED.
